 SAR continues for 74-year-old doctor in Tanjung Bungah
 By IMRAN HILMY 
 Monday, 16 Nov 2026
 | 11:30 AM MYT

 GEORGE TOWN: A multi-agency search and rescue (SAR) operation resumed on Monday (Nov 16) for a 74-year-old doctor who went missing while windsurfing near Tanjung Bungah.
 Penang Fire and Rescue Department assistant director of operations John Sagun Francis said the search area has been expanded to 94.76 square nautical miles, divided into five sectors around the waters where the victim was last seen.
 "In addition to surface searches, aerial reconnaissance is being conducted via helicopter," he said in a statement.
 An incident command post has been established at the scene to coordinate efforts between the Fire and Rescue Department, the Malaysian Maritime Enforcement Agency (MMEA), the police, the Civil Defence Force, and a local voluntary fire squad.
 The septuagenarian was reported missing at 7.42pm on Sunday (Nov 15) after failing to return from a windsurfing session in the waters off the Chinese Swimming Club in Tanjung Bungah.
